snippet.title: News Tower - 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
📰 News Tower is now available in full access on Steam on PC and Mac. 

Get yours now with a 20% discount, only until December 2nd! ➡ http://bit.ly/NewsTower

🏗️ Build a newspaper empire that is profitable, independent, and that covers trustworthy news - or not...
✍️ Recruit the best reporters, obtain the latest news and become New York’s media mogul! 
🗞️ Create your editorial line, select your topics on the globe and compose your newspaper each week to meet your readers’ expectations. You will need to keep an eye on their interests!

👉 Join the community on Discord:  https://discord.gg/3MwVhgqtea

👉 Be the first reporter informed on Twitter:   https://x.com/NewsTowerGame

Subscribe to this channel to stay tuned! 

#newstower #newspaper #tycoon
